statement: Usage traditionnel : soulagement des premiers symptômes du rhume.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Sambucus nigra L., flos (EMA/HMPC/611512/2016, revision 1)
source.quote: Traditional herbal medicinal product used for the relief of early symptoms of common cold.

statement: Usage traditionnel, adolescents, adultes et personnes âgées : tisane de 2 à 5 g de fleurs dans 150 ml d'eau bouillante, trois fois par jour.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Sambucus nigra L., flos (EMA/HMPC/611512/2016, revision 1)
source.quote: Herbal tea: 2-5 g of the herbal substance or comminuted herbal substance in 150 ml boiling water as a herbal infusion three times daily.

statement: Durée : si les symptômes persistent plus de 1 semaine, consulter un médecin ou un professionnel de santé.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Sambucus nigra L., flos (EMA/HMPC/611512/2016, revision 1)
source.quote: If the symptoms persist longer than 1 week during the use of the medicinal product, a doctor or a qualified health care practitioner should be consulted.

statement: Contre-indiqué en cas d'hypersensibilité à la substance active.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Sambucus nigra L., flos (EMA/HMPC/611512/2016, revision 1)

statement: Usage non établi chez les moins de 12 ans (données insuffisantes).

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Sambucus nigra L., flos (EMA/HMPC/611512/2016, revision 1)
source.quote: The use in children under 12 years of age has not been established due to lack of adequate data.

statement: Si les symptômes s'aggravent pendant l'utilisation, consulter un médecin ou un professionnel de santé.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Sambucus nigra L., flos (EMA/HMPC/611512/2016, revision 1)
source.quote: If the symptoms worsen during the use of the medicinal product, a doctor or a qualified health care practitioner should be consulted.

statement: En cas de dyspnée, de fièvre ou d'expectorations purulentes, consulter un médecin ou un professionnel de santé.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Sambucus nigra L., flos (EMA/HMPC/611512/2016, revision 1)
source.quote: If dyspnoea, fever or purulent sputum occurs, a doctor or a qualified health care practitioner should be consulted.

statement: Aucune interaction rapportée dans la monographie EMA (usage traditionnel). Ne vaut pas absence d'interaction.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Sambucus nigra L., flos (EMA/HMPC/611512/2016, revision 1)

statement: Sécurité pendant la grossesse et l'allaitement non établie ; usage non recommandé en l'absence de données suffisantes.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Sambucus nigra L., flos (EMA/HMPC/611512/2016, revision 1)
source.quote: Safety during pregnancy and lactation has not been established. In the absence of sufficient data, the use during pregnancy and lactation is not recommended.

statement: Aucune étude sur l'aptitude à conduire et à utiliser des machines n'a été réalisée.

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Sambucus nigra L., flos (EMA/HMPC/611512/2016, revision 1)
